title: Pasilla RNAi knock-down RNA-seq gene-count example
kind: study observations and sample annotations packaged as DESeq2 example assets
study_ids: Brooks2010 as cited in DESeq2 vignette; exact accession not inspected
provenance: Vignette identifies the underlying experiment as Drosophila melanogaster cell cultures examining RNAi knock-down of the splicing factor pasilla, citing Brooks2010. It says these data were copied from the pasilla package into DESeq2 inst/extdata. The two assets below are therefore grouped as raw gene-count and sample-annotation representations for the same stated example; this grouping is based on the vignette's paired loading code, not a comparison of full contents.

biological_context.experimental_units: cell-culture samples; seven sample annotation rows
biological_context.assay: RNA-seq; sample sheet reports sequencing type and read counts
biological_context.design: RNAi knock-down of pasilla; vignette analyzes condition treated versus untreated and demonstrates sequencing type as a covariate
metadata: sample table reports number of lanes, total reads and exon counts

assets.stage: gene-level counts used directly as countData; vignette calls these read counts
sample metadata aligned to gene-count matrix columns after name normalization/reordering
assets.relationship: paired sample annotation; source preview contains seven sample records

access_and_terms: Repository is public. DESeq2 DESCRIPTION reports package license LGPL (>= 3), but no inspected evidence establishes reuse terms for the underlying Pasilla observations or copied data assets. Source: https://github.com/thelovelab/DESeq2/blob/c62c60c6ff83fd84ce115cacd1c49827533f85a7/DESCRIPTION; data source identified by vignette as Bioconductor pasilla package https://bioconductor.org/packages/pasilla (not inspected).
inspection: Read vignette data-loading and metadata alignment instructions (lines 402-485), Pasilla biological description (644-649), and multifactor example (1116-1188). Read the complete 527-byte sample annotation CSV; it lists treated1-3 and untreated1-4, with condition, sequencing type, lanes, total reads, exon counts. Count matrix itself was not downloaded or previewed; tree API reported size 167602 bytes.
limitations: Exact upstream accession, original package release, genome build, annotation, cell culture details, and terms for study data remain unknown.
The sample annotation states lane/read/exon-count fields, but their definitions and study-level provenance were not independently checked.
No checksum, current download test, or count/sample identifier cross-check against the count matrix was performed.
Source package license does not establish license for the data.

title: tximportData Salmon quantification demonstration
kind: example quantification files, mapping annotation, and sample metadata
provenance: The pinned DESeq2 vignette states its tximport and tx2gene demonstration files are stored in the tximportData package. It explicitly assigns artificial condition labels A and B to the sample table for demonstration; these do not document an observed experimental comparison. The quantification, transcript-gene mapping, and sample sheet are linked by the vignette's paths and tximport call, but biological provenance and relationships among underlying samples were not independently inspected.

biological_context.assay: Transcript abundance quantification by Salmon, per vignette
biological_context.design: Artificial condition factor A/B assigned in demonstration; not an observed study contrast
metadata: sample table columns include pop, center and run as used in vignette

assets.format: Salmon quant.sf.gz per sample under tximportData/extdata/salmon/<run>/
assets.stage: transcript-level abundance estimates consumed by tximport
assets.relationship: demonstration quantifier outputs; individual files not inspected

assets.stage: annotation used to summarize transcript estimates to genes
assets.relationship: mapping explicitly passed as tx2gene to tximport

assets.stage: sample/run metadata with artificial condition labels assigned in vignette
assets.relationship: selects per-run quantification file paths and supplies colData

access_and_terms: Only package identity/link is reported by the DESeq2 vignette. Package contents, current access, source-study terms, and reuse rights were not inspected; public package access must not be treated as reuse permission.
inspection: Read pinned DESeq2 vignette lines 254-359. No tximportData files were retrieved or previewed.
limitations: Study, accession, organism, number and identity of runs, exact package release and license are unverified.
Artificial A/B condition values are teaching scaffolding and must not be interpreted as biological observations.
Genome/annotation compatibility of v27 mapping with quantification files is assumed by vignette path naming but not independently checked.
